title: Federal funding evidence and the complete public EPiQS grant portfolio for Institutional Atlas V2

methodology.source: NSF Awards API and official agency, national laboratory and university announcements; Moore Foundation official grant database and initiative-filtered portfolio
methodology.selection: 42 previously selected federal records plus all 135 grants in Moore’s EPiQS-filtered public listing, checked 4 November 2026. Complete coverage applies to that EPiQS snapshot only, not all quantum-materials funding.
methodology.universe: 177 distinct records: 42 federal + 135 private-foundation EPiQS grants.
methodology.aggregation: Deduplicate by record ID, preserving agency identity. Only cumulative obligations with a named recipient enter recipient-obligation sums. Whole-center totals, program investments and contract ceilings are not added to obligations or assigned to individual consortium members. Distinct-project counts collapse renewal phases using projectKey.

scopeDefinitions.quantum-materials: Award abstract explicitly centers research/training on quantum materials; includes full award administration and education, not pure research spend.
scopeDefinitions.mixed-materials: Whole materials-center award includes quantum-materials and other research; quantum-only budget is unknown.
scopeDefinitions.broader-qis: Whole quantum information science institute award; contains materials connections but not restricted to quantum materials.
scopeDefinitions.mixed-initiative: Grant explicitly supports EPiQS and another initiative; EPiQS-only allocation unknown.
scopeDefinitions.research-on-research: Metascience study of quantum-materials research, not a physical quantum-materials laboratory.

limitations: NSF cumulative obligations, announced consortium totals, contract ceilings and planned investments have different meanings and are not summed together.
No comprehensive national or institutional funding total is claimed. Missing records or institutional shares mean not assessed, not zero.
Partnership links are specific to the cited phase and include only institutions mapped in this atlas; they are not complete membership rosters.
Five-year planned DOE outyear funding is subject to congressional appropriations; announced totals are not proof of full obligations or expenditure.
Renewals count as separate funding-phase records, but once per project for project-count highlights.
Whole MRSEC and QIS awards include work beyond quantum materials; the quantum-materials-only amount is not established.
Directory milestones and funding announcements may refer to the same broader development. Timeline event counts are not grant counts or monetary totals.

Private-foundation grants are a separate amount basis from federal obligations. The award month and database term do not establish actual disbursement dates. The EPiQS initiative envelope is not added to individual grants.

All 135 unique grants visible in the official EPiQS initiative-filtered public listing checked 4 November 2026. Excludes unpublished awards and other initiatives, including Experimental Physics Investigators. The public listing may change after this date.
methodology.recommendedUiLabel: Funding linked to a host: named recipient, lead, or documented partner
methodology.recommendedMissingLabel: No matching grant documented in this coverage
methodology.retrieval: Previous federal evidence and its check dates retained; Moore Foundation grants checked 4 November 2026. Award months are not asserted as project-start dates.
